document:4:507:0.text:
To our friend far away, Merlin,

Happy Emberlight Festival. I hope you're doing well, wherever you are. Carolina, Ludovic, and the rest of us have been thinking about you.

Ever since Shemira's family settled in Whiteridge, something about this silent land has started to change. It's still a place for the undead and the forgotten, but somehow, it feels a little less cold than before. People who used to keep to themselves now gather beneath the eaves of Ludovic's manor, speaking in hushed voices, trading long-forgotten memories. Maybe that's the true gift of the Emberlight Festival this year—the return of life.

Now that the festival is here, all of us—Ludovic, Carolina, Callan, Shemira, Niru, little Daimon, and plenty of others whose names you might not remember—have gathered together at Everstill Manor. The fire crackles in the hearth, its warm light brightening up faces that once looked so lonely. We may not be able to join the living in their celebrations, nor set foot in Avalon, but in spirit, we're already there celebrating with everyone, across the boundaries of life and death.

I hope this letter reaches you, carried by the warmth of Emberlight. And may its light guide you through every step of the year ahead.

Your eternal friend,
Valka
Eve of the Emberlight Festival, at Everstill Manor
document:4:507:0.source_cn:
致我们远方的朋友，梅林：
春焰庆安乐。不知远方的你是否一切安好？我与卡列琳娜、柳博米尔等人都牵挂着你。
自雪米拉一家搬来白山，这片寂静的疆土——亡灵与活死人聚集之地，似乎也因他们的到来而多了一些……温暖。往昔独行的同伴，如今开始在柳博米尔的永寂庄园廊下轻声交谈，分享着各自尘封的记忆。这份久违的生命力，或许是春焰庆最出乎意料的礼物。
值此佳节，我们——我、柳博米尔、卡列琳娜、铐兰、雪米拉、尼汝和可爱的戴蒙，以及许多你或许叫不出名字的朋友——正聚集在永寂庄园里。幽火在壁炉中安静地燃烧，映照着不再孤单的身影。尽管我们无法亲身感受生者们热闹欢乐的庆典，也不便前往阿瓦隆，但我们的心绪早已跨越生与死的界限，与所有人一同享受这节日的氛围。
愿此信能借由春焰的暖意，平安抵达你的手中。也愿春焰的星火，为你照亮新岁的每一段旅程。
你永恒的朋友，
瓦丽卡
春焰庆前夕，于永寂庄园
